q1: SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves WHERE beer IN (SELECT s.beer FROM serves AS s, frequents AS f WHERE s.bar = f.bar AND f.drinker LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY s.beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.bar) >= 2) GROUP BY beer ORDER BY beer
q2: SELECT DISTINCT beer, ((SELECT MAX(price) FROM serves AS S WHERE S.beer = beer) - (SELECT MIN(price) FROM serves AS S WHERE S.beer = beer)) AS diff, (SELECT AVG(price) FROM serves AS S WHERE S.beer = beer) FROM (SELECT beer, bar FROM serves NATURAL JOIN frequents GROUP BY bar, beer HAVING (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frequents AS F WHERE F.bar = bar AND F.drinker LIKE 'B%') >= 2 ORDER BY bar) AS br
